label: bio-based plastic object
definition: A plastic object that is primarily made of bio-based plastic.

label: biodegradable plastic object
definition: A plastic object that is primarily made of biodegradable plastic.

label: compostable plastic object
definition: A plastic object that is primarily made of compostable plastic.

label: macro-particle of plastic
definition: A piece of plastic that is 1 cm or more in its largest dimension.

label: mega-particle of plastic
definition: A piece of plastic that is greater than 1 meter in its largest dimension.

label: meso-particle of plastic
definition: A piece of plastic that is between 1 and 10 mm in its largest dimension.

label: micro-particle of plastic
definition: A piece of plastic that is between 1 and 1000 µm in its largest dimension.

label: nano-particle of plastic
definition: A piece of plastic that is between 1 and 1000 nm in its largest dimension.

label: piece of bio-based plastic
definition: A piece of synthetic plastic that is primarily made of bio-based plastic.

label: piece of biodegradable plastic
definition: A piece of plastic that is primarily made of biodegradable plastic.

label: piece of biodegradable synthetic plastic
definition: A piece of synthetic plastic that is primarily made of biodegradable plastic.

label: piece of compostable synthetic plastic
definition: A piece of biodegradable plastic that is primarily made of compostable plastic.

label: piece of recyclable plastic
definition: A piece of synthetic plastic that is primarily made of recyclable plastic.

label: piece of recycled plastic
definition: A piece of synthetic plastic that is primarily made of recycled plastic.

label: piece of synthetic plastic
definition: A piece of plastic that is made of synthetic plastic.

label: piece of virgin plastic
definition: A piece of synthetic plastic that is primarily made of virgin plastic.

label: plastic film
definition: A piece of synthetic plastic which is flexible, thin, and planar.

label: plastic fragment
definition: A piece of plastic that is an output of a plastic fragmentation process.

label: plastic line
definition: A piece of plastic which is linear and flexible.

label: plastic nurdle
definition: A plastic pellet that is manufactured in such a way that its size enables quick melting thereby making it usable for further downstream manufacturing processes.

label: plastic object
definition: A piece of plastic that bears some function(s).

label: plastic pellet
definition: A piece of solid (at room temperature) synthetic plastic which is 1) hard, 2) has a smooth external surface, and 3) has a roughly spherical or granular shape.

definition: A plastic object that is primarily made of recyclable plastic.

definition: A plastic object that is primarily made of recycled plastic.
